document.about: HMRC SA100 2026 tax return. Its amount boxes set a £ alone before each box, a column of its own beside the box's figures.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#401): a £ alone on its line, set just left of the box's figures, was read as a list marker and consumed. A currency sign is never a marker.

checks.issue: #401: the £ before the box for the Winter Fuel Payment received was read as a list marker and lost; the form's two other £ boxes set as figures kept theirs.
